correctness.rationale: There are 36 windows, since one of three symbols is doubled and the locations and ordering can be chosen in 6 and 2 ways. Euler circuits in the overlap graph give exactly the cyclic words, since the 36 arcs are the distinct consecutive windows and fixing the unique 0120 normalizes rotation once. At an all-distinct state abc the three completions trace paths of lengths 1,2,3 to bca,cba,cab respectively; the intermediate vertices each have a unique predecessor and successor, and the paths exhaust the 36 arcs. The six states form the bidirected triangular prism, with 75 spanning trees from the product Laplacian, giving 75 in-arborescences at the root and 75·(2!)^6 by fixed-first-edge BEST. An independent direct search on the uncontracted arcs enumerated 4,800 such words and verified their windows. The stated representative is in that set and is the least lexicographic word when rooted at 0120. The frozen cycle script prints its first witness rather than explicitly asserting equality to the printed representative; the independent check verified membership directly.
residual_risks: The count treats rotations only, with labeled symbols and distinct reversal unless it is already a rotation. No larger-order result follows.
